aliases: WhiteFiber Madison AI Data Center Campus
status_detail: Rockingham County Economic Development announced WhiteFiber acquired a 96-acre, approximately 1 million-square-foot former industrial site in Madison for an HPC/AI data center campus; 24 MW expected online by end of 2025, 99 MW secured, scalable to 200 MW.
notes: County and company sources align on Madison, former Unifi site, 96 acres, roughly 1M sf, $1B-plus planned investment, and 60-plus jobs. Capacity_mw uses initial 24 MW; notes retain 99 MW secured / 200 MW possible scale.

status_detail: City of Salisbury official data-center information page says Trammell Crow and Flexential are interested in constructing and operating a data center on about 94 acres at 1477 Henderson Grove Church Road; the facility would be about 400,000 square feet and has not been approved.
notes: Official city page says no incentive is recommended or requested and no incentive has been approved. Salisbury Post reports the later text-amendment process, but project-level approval was not found.
